basic_info.description: Prime Dolores Heights. Walls of glass. Skyline for days. Reimagined from its duplex roots into a luxurious single-family residence, 3838 19th Street delivers two dramatic levels of indoor-outdoor living with sweeping downtown views from virtually every vantage. A double-height entry atrium sets the tone, leading to grand, glass-wrapped living and dining spaces above and a lounge level that opens wide to a walk-out deck. Entertain at the show-stopping built-in bar clad in gorgeous artisan tile, or slide open the doors upstairs to a view balcony for sunset cocktails. An interior terrace and garden create a private backdrop for al-fresco dinners at scale. Add a wine cellar, laundry room, and rare 2-car, side-by-side carport, and you have the ultimate city homeequal parts polished, playful, and unmistakably San Francisco. On a coveted Dolores Heights block just steps to Dolores Park, you're minutes from the Valencia Corridor and the Castro's destination restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and boutiques. Commuting is easy with the J-Church Muni nearby and excellent bike routes at your doorurban living with a resort-level view.
